title: Delegate the Entra Policy Suite hybrid worker's gMSA in Active Directory
purpose: Gives the hybrid worker the right to write exactly the tag attributes you choose on user objects anywhere in the domain (device tags are written in Entra ID, not in AD) - one inheritable ACE per attribute and object class at the domain root, granted to the group <gMSA>-PermissionGroup (the gMSA its only member), nothing else. Plan first: without -Apply nothing is changed; with -Apply every change is read back.
whenToRun: Once before the worker is installed, and again when a tag type moves to another attribute.

runAs.name: a domain admin
runAs.why: makes the permission group if missing and adds the ACEs

changes.object: <gMSA>-PermissionGroup (when missing), in the gMSA's container, the gMSA its only member
changes.why: every AD right of the worker goes to this group, never to the gMSA (framework HYBRID-AD-1)

changes.permission: WriteProperty on each attribute you list, inherited by descendant user (and with -ObjectClasses computer, computer) objects
changes.why: the worker writes the tags of AD-synced users (and devices)

changes.permission: WriteProperty on the same attributes, on the object itself
changes.why: protected admin accounts get their tags too (a Tier 0 decision)

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.help: your tag attributes (extensionAttribute1-15 only) - no default, they differ per customer

parameters.name: ObjectClasses
parameters.help: user (the default); computer is accepted, but no feature writes computer objects today

parameters.name: ProductOu
parameters.help: not used by Entra Policy Suite (it owns no AD objects); the shared parameter of the hybrid worker scripts

parameters.name: IncludeProtectedAccounts
parameters.help: also protected admin accounts (AdminSDHolder) - makes the worker Tier 0

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: make the changes and read them back

parameters.name: Remove
parameters.help: remove the ACEs instead (the group stays)

readsOnly: the gMSA, the schema's attribute ids, the OUs' permissions
whatIf: Without -Apply (or with -WhatIf): every ACE it would add or remove and the ones already there.
